spans.s:
m. (-ट्टः)
A market, a moveable market, a fair.
f. (-ट्टी)
A petty market or fair.
E.
हट to shine, ट aff., form irr.

m. (-कः)
A thief, one stealing at fairs and markets.
E.
हट्ट a market, and चौर a thief, कन् pleonasm.

f. (-नी)
1 A sort of drug and perfume.
2 A whore.
E.
हट्ट a market, विलस to wanton or delight, णिनि and ङीप् aff.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Golden, of gold, (as a weight or coin.)
n. (-कं)
Gold.
E.
हट to shine, ण्वुल् aff.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
Made of gold, golden.
E.
हाटक gold, मयट् aff.
